D: A scrappy band of misfits teams up to keep a powerful orb out of a fanatic's hands.
P: Serve the snacks when Quill puts his mixtape on.
S: Puff pastry rolls filled with pizza sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella

Crisp golden pastry rolls stuffed with pepperoni, mozzarella and pizza sauce, baked until bubbling, with a hot honey and chilli marinara for dunking. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 8 rectangles each. Put 1 tsp pizza sauce, 2 slices pepperoni and a pinch of grated mozzarella and oregano on each, roll up and pinch the ends closed. Lay seam down on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and scatter with parmesan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Warm 300ml napoli sauce with 1 tbsp honey and a big pinch of chilli flakes to dip.
Baked wings tossed in a sticky blackberry, soy, honey and chilli glaze
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky purple glaze of blackberry, soy, chilli and honey.
Groot charred broccolini with whipped feta
Groot, regrowing in his little pot

Broccolini and green beans blanched, then charred in a smoking pan with garlic and chilli, piled over whipped feta with lemon and toasted almonds. Blend 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and a little olive oil until smooth and spread on a platter. Blanch 2 bunches broccolini and 200g green beans for 1 minute, drain and pat dry. Char in a smoking hot pan with olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes, adding 2 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes at the end. Pile over the feta, squeeze over lemon and scatter with toasted flaked almonds.
M: Ravager barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
Slow-baked paprika pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, grilled corn
Pork ribs rubbed and slow-baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed under the grill with a smoky barbecue sauce, with corn and slaw.

Tender beef and pork meatloaf lacquered in a sticky gochujang, brown sugar and tomato glaze, sliced thick on creamy mash with buttered corn and onion gravy. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tsp mustard and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined tray. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 1 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, brush half over and bake at 180C for 50 minutes, adding the rest halfway. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with mash, buttered corn kernels and gravy from 1 sliced onion, 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.
W: Vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and rainbow sprinkles
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, rainbow sprinkles, whipped cream and a sparkler for the final move.
K: Grenadine, lemonade and blue raspberry cordial layered over ice, no alcohol
A spoon of grenadine in the bottom of each glass, then lemonade over ice, then blue raspberry cordial poured slowly down a spoon so it layers like a nebula.

Roll up, pinch the ends closed and lay seam down on the trays.
Brush with egg, scatter with parmesan and bake until puffed and golden.

veg.n: Awesome Mix mushroom and capsicum pizza rolls
veg.make_ahead: Rolls can be filled a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line trays. Cut each pastry sheet into 8 rectangles.
Fry the mushrooms and capsicum in the oil until dry, then cool.
Top each rectangle with pizza sauce, the mushroom mix, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll up, pinch the ends closed and lay seam down on the trays.
Brush with egg, scatter with the cheese and bake until puffed and golden.
Warm the napoli sauce with the honey and chilli flakes for dipping.

dishes.make_ahead: Wings can dry in the fridge overnight

steps.text: Dry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Simmer the blackberries with the soy, honey, garlic and chilli until sticky, then strain.
Toss the wings through the glaze.

veg.make_ahead: Glaze up to 2 days ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Whisk the flour, water and salt to a thin batter.
Coat the cauliflower and bake on a lined tray until crisp, turning once.
Simmer the blackberries with the soy, honey, garlic and chilli until sticky, then strain.
Toss the cauliflower through the glaze and bake for 5 more minutes.

dishes.n: Ravager barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
dishes.make_ahead: Ribs can be baked a day ahead, glaze to serve

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika and sugar and wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 150C until tender.
Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under the grill.
Grill the corn until charred.
Toss the slaw mix with mayonnaise and serve.

veg.n: Ravager barbecue jackfruit with corn and slaw
veg.make_ahead: Jackfruit can be baked a day ahead, glaze to serve

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Pull the jackfruit into shreds and toss with the oil, paprika and sugar.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C until browned at the edges.
Stir through the barbecue sauce and glaze under the grill.
Grill the corn until charred.
Toss the slaw mix with mayonnaise and serve with the jackfruit in the rolls.

dishes.make_ahead: Fudge sauce up to 3 days, chilled

steps.text: Melt the chocolate into the cream for the hot fudge.
Scoop the ice cream into tall glasses.
Pour over the fudge and add whipped cream and sprinkles.
Light a sparkler for the final move.

dishes.make_ahead: Best built just before serving to keep the layers and fizz; chill the lemonade the day before

steps.text: Put a spoon of grenadine in the bottom of each of four glasses.
Fill with ice and lemonade.
Pour the cordial slowly down a spoon so it layers like a nebula.

m.note: Slow-baked paprika pork ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, grilled corn
